## Description and Rationale

I am a data enthusiast and machine learning practitioner passionate about solving real-world operational challenges. I decided to register for the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to apply my predictive modeling skills to the complex dynamics of aviation data. Predicting taxi-out times presents a fascinating optimization problem, and I am excited to contribute to open science and improve European aviation efficiency.
